entity.summary: Tehran-based Iranian centralized cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2018 and currently offering spot and easy trading, API access, trading bots, leveraged products, staking and related account services. The U.S. Treasury's OFAC designated Ramzinex on June 2, 2026 pursuant to Executive Order 13902 for operating in Iran's financial sector.
entity.notes: Treasury identifies Ramzinex as a Tehran-based digital-asset exchange founded in 2018. HEI uses 2018-01-01 as a year-level launch marker because the reviewed source establishes the year but not an exact day. The current first-party site exposes live markets, professional and easy trading, trading bots, API trading, leverage, staking, loans and other exchange services. The June 2 OFAC designation is recorded as a regulatory event but does not by itself establish operational closure, so active status is retained.

events.title: U.S. Treasury designated Ramzinex under Iran sanctions authority
events.description: The U.S. Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control designated Ramzinex pursuant to Executive Order 13902 for operating in the financial sector of the Iranian economy.
events.notes: Treasury describes Ramzinex as a Tehran-based digital-asset exchange founded in 2018. HEI records the sanctions designation without inferring a shutdown because the first-party exchange platform remained operational in August 2026.
